- Build a complete, playable 2D top-down anime soccer game with solo AI matches and an online-style matchmaking simulation.

## Requirements
- Start players with 10 gold; shop skills cost 100 gold each.
- Include speed burst, power shot, and shadow dribble.

- Implemented as a standalone HTML/CSS/JavaScript game without external game-engine dependencies.
- Matchmaking simulates a short queue before starting a local AI match.
- Player profile persists in local storage with a stored integrity seal.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 2D top-down anime soccer game with solo AI matches and an online-style matchmaking simulation.

- Implemented as standalone HTML/CSS/JavaScript with no game-engine dependency.
- Matchmaking simulates a short queue before starting a local AI match.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 2D top-down anime soccer game with solo AI matches and an online-style matchmaking simulation.

## Requirements
- Start with 10 gold; skills cost 100 gold each, including speed burst, power shot, and shadow dribble.
- Validate modified player stats and coins; admin password `ADMIN-BLUE-2026` grants unlimited coins, all abilities, and max stats.
- Support mobile landscape with responsive UI, vector graphics, virtual joystick, and action buttons for sprint, pass, shoot, tackle, and special ability.

- Implemented as standalone HTML/CSS/JavaScript with no game-engine dependency.
- Matchmaking simulates a short queue before starting a local AI match.
